description: Sends your answer to exactly one participant question by email and marks the question as answered in the live console. Take it when a question deserves an answer after the webinar. A host says: "Answer the question about the course, she asked before we ended." It needs the session, the webinar, the question and the answer, and the question is taken from the list the site returns, never from memory. The answer goes out as the host wrote it, so read it back when they spoke it out loud. It sends a real email from your site to that participant and writes the answer into the console; nothing else changes. A subject line is optional. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: answer a question, reply by email, mark as answered, participant asked

answer.description: The host's answer, as it should be read by the participant.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

subject.description: The subject of the answer email. Leave it out and the site uses its own.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_answer_webinar_question
title: Answer one participant question by email
